understanding: Count customers per employee via SupportRepId, listing all employees with 0 when none.
reason: LEFT JOIN with COUNT(c.CustomerId) gives 0 for employees without customers and matches expected.

understanding: List every employee with their direct manager's full name, blank when no manager.
expected: Andrew Adams|NULL; Nancy Edwards|Andrew Adams; Jane Peacock|Nancy Edwards; Steve Park|Nancy Edwards; Solo Lone|NULL
reason: Self LEFT JOIN keeps employees without manager with NULL manager_name.

understanding: Top 3 artists by retail revenue from German customers in 2024, descending.
edge_cases: non-German customer invoice with huge revenue in 2024
reason: The query never filters on Germany (no Customer join or BillingCountry condition), so the French customer's revenue for A5 appears and A3 is dropped.

understanding: Top 3 genres by average track length in minutes (2 decimals), longest first.
edge_cases: genre whose SUM ranks differently from AVG (Metal 3 tracks)
track with NULL GenreId and huge length
reason: Uses AVG, inner join excludes NULL-genre tracks, ordering and rounding correct.

understanding: Average invoice total per billing country, only countries with at least 20 invoices.
edge_cases: country with exactly 20 invoices but small sum (10)
reason: HAVING SUM(Total) >= 20 filters on revenue instead of invoice count, wrongly including B (3 invoices) and excluding C (20 invoices).

understanding: Count artists who never sold any track, including artists with no albums.
edge_cases: artist with album but no tracks
reason: The extra EXISTS-album condition excludes artists with no albums, which the question explicitly says to include.

understanding: Percentage of retail revenue per media type over total revenue, rounded to 2 decimals.
reason: CASTing sums to INTEGER truncates the values and does integer division, giving wrong percentages.

understanding: Number of tracks for each Iron Maiden album (title, count).
edge_cases: album with 2 tracks and another with 1
reason: GROUP BY ar.ArtistId collapses all albums into one row, so counts are per artist rather than per album.

understanding: Countries having at least 5 customers, with customer counts.
reason: GROUP BY Country with HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 handles the boundary and excludes NULL country.

understanding: Top 5 customers by total spend in 2024 with name and total, descending.
expected: Bob B 20, Ann Lee 15, Dan D 12, Ann Lee 11, Eve E 9
got: Bob B 20, Ann Lee 15, Dan D 12, Ann Lee 11, Eve E 9
reason: Date range handles end-of-year timestamps, grouping by CustomerId keeps same-name customers separate, ordering and limit right.
